name: Aidan Goodyer
intro: I’m a software engineer who likes following interesting problems wherever they lead.
about: I started programming almost a decade ago by moving an orange cat around in
. I've been finding new corners of computing to poke at ever since.

I tend to gravitate toward problems with some ambiguity or unfamiliar territory in them. That curiosity has taken me through infrastructure, distributed applications, machine learning, and the occasional robot.
. These days, I'm working in Toronto and still finding plenty to explore.

experience.description: Building reusable CI/CD workflows and platform tooling with Terraform, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud.

Built backend services for streaming application data using TypeScript and AWS CDK, replacing a legacy integration and reducing maintenance costs. Rolled out VPC networking and distributed tracing with AWS X-Ray across all services.
Developed CI/CD platform features in Go and Java Spring used by dozens of developer teams. Led migration work for several on-premises services and developed ETLs for fraud monitoring.
Prepared and presented workshops on machine learning fundamentals, with practical demos using PyTorch, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow.
Contributed to an internal monitoring tool, building front-end components with Vue and Nuxt and integrating REST APIs to display employee status data.

projects.title: Chive
projects.description: An open-source recipe app built on the AT Protocol. Recipes stay in their authors’ repositories rather than an application database, while the static client discovers and reads them directly from the network.

projects.title: InfraRAT
projects.imageAlt: InfraRAT mouse mascot surrounded by colourful directional arrows
projects.description: A research platform for exploring 20,000+ experimental sessions in behavioural neuroscience, built with McMaster’s Szechtman Lab. Normalized session metadata connects back to original research files for querying and analysis.

projects.title: BirdScout
projects.imageAlt: BirdScout field journal displayed on a phone against a blue sky
projects.description: A mobile app for identifying, recording, and exploring bird sightings, built to handle uncertain species identification, persistent sighting records, and location privacy.

projects.title: GoTracer
projects.imageAlt: A scene rendered by the raytracing engine
projects.description: A 3D raytracer built using only the Go standard library. Bounding volume hierarchies and multithreading produced a 36× speedup over the naïve implementation.

projects.title: TicTacToeBot
projects.description: A fully wireless robot built for the 2023 MEC Senior Design Challenge. It achieved the fastest completion time and placed second overall.

projects.title: Procedural island generator
projects.description: A program that generates islands from a Voronoi mesh and exports them to SVG or OBJ.

projects.title: Spotify Higher/Lower
projects.description: A game that asks players to guess how their favourite artists rank on global charts using data from Spotify.
